async function pool(fns, n) { const out = []; let i = 0; const run = async () => { while (i < fns.length) { const k = i++; out[k] = await fns[k](); } }; await Promise.all(Array.from({ length: Math.min(n, fns.length) }, run)); return out; }

/**
 * Runs async tasks with at most n running at once, preserving result order.
 *
 * The inner run() worker repeatedly takes the next unstarted task until none remain.
 * @param {!Array<function(): !Promise<*>>} fns The task factories.
 * @param {number} n The maximum concurrency.
 * @return {!Promise<!Array<*>>} The results, indexed like fns.
 */
